title: When Does Less Information Pay? An Exact Finite Atlas of Representation, Payoff, and Cost
abstract: arXiv:2611.17583v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A representation that retains one bit about a four-state world can solve a task perfectly, while another that retains 1.5 bits on average reaches only 75% accuracy. The difference lies in which distinctions each representation preserves. We examine this relationship in a uniform four-state world by enumerating all admissible representations and binary action rules. Constructions are compared both by replacing one component while holding the others fixed and by choosing the best action rule separately for each module. We consider three tasks, their mixtures, and four separate hypothetical cost tariffs.   In some comparisons, the representation retaining less world information has the higher payoff; in others, the more informative representation does. translated_title: 何时更少的信息反而更有价值？表征、收益与成本的精确有限图集
translated_abstract: 一个关于四状态世界仅保留一比特信息的表征可以完美地解决某项任务，而另一个平均保留1.5比特信息的表征却只能达到75%的准确率。差异在于每个表征各自保留了哪些区分。我们在一个均匀的四状态世界中，通过枚举所有可采纳的表征和二元动作规则来考察这种关系。这些构造的比较方式有两种：一种是固定其他组件而替换其中一个组件，另一种是为每个模块单独选择最优动作规则。我们考虑了三个任务、它们的混合情形，以及四种独立的假设性成本费率。在某些比较中，保留较少世界信息的表征获得了更高的收益；而在另一些比较中，信息量更大的表征收益更高。还存在一些信息量不同但收益相等（即任务准确率相等）的配对。如果一个表征保留了所有现有的区分并添加了新的区分，其最优的零……
tldr: 该论文在四状态世界中穷举所有可采纳的表征与二元动作规则，精确刻画了信息保留量、任务收益与信息成本之间的完整对应关系，证明信息更少的表征在某些情形下反而能取得更高收益。
en_tdlr: By exhaustively enumerating all admissible representations and binary action rules in a four-state world, the paper builds an exact finite atlas of the relationship between retained information, payoff, and cost, showing when representations with less world information can yield higher payoff.
